speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're struggling with sadness, hearing voices, and difficulty concentrating at work. To better understand the root cause, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been occurring?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient has been brought in by her boyfriend due to a 4-month history of feeling persistently sad. She reports that she has had significant trouble sleeping and eating during this period, and her ability to concentrate at work has deteriorated. She describes a feeling of emptiness and experiences auditory hallucinations, specifically voices telling her she is worthless. speaker: Doctor
text: Are those voices currently telling you to harm yourself or others, and have you ever experienced a period where you felt unusually energetic, needed very little sleep, or had racing thoughts? REQUEST TEST: Mood_Disturbance_Screening, Auditory_Hallucination_Assessment

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mood_Disturbance_Screening: Positive for Major Depressive Episode (persistent sadness, sleep/eating disturbance, concentration issues, emptiness, worthlessness). Auditory_Hallucination_Assessment: Positive for command-independent hallucinations (derogatory content, voices mocking patient); patient denies current intent to harm self or others.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those results; they confirm a major depressive episode with auditory hallucinations. To clarify the nature of your illness, have you experienced any episodes of elevated mood, increased energy, or decreased need for sleep in the past, and do you have a family history of schizophrenia or bipolar disorder? REQUEST TEST: Psychiatric_History_Screening, Family_Psych_Genetics

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Psychiatric_History_Screening: No history of elevated mood, increased energy, or decreased need for sleep reported by patient. Family_Psych_Genetics: No family history of schizophrenia or bipolar disorder reported.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Major Depressive Disorder with psychotic features. REQUEST IMAGES: None needed at this time.
